subject.title: [Bug]: codex agent fails ("exited with code 1") — macOS XProtect deletes bundled @openai/codex@0.128.0 as malware; codex-acp@0.0.44 pins the flagged version

question: Should acpx fix this Codex startup failure by bumping the owned Codex adapter range only, by adding diagnostics/docs only, or by also injecting a system `codex` fallback when `CODEX_PATH` is unset?
rationale: The adapter range and fallback behavior are part of acpx's user-visible launcher contract, and AGENTS.md says these conventions need scrutiny before being changed.

options.title: Bump adapter with diagnostics
options.body: Compat-test a newer `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp` range, update registry/tests/docs/skill notes, and add enough startup diagnostics for blocked or missing nested Codex binaries.

options.title: Docs and diagnostics only
options.body: Keep the current adapter pin for now while documenting `CODEX_PATH` and improving the error message so affected users can recover manually.

options.title: Add system Codex fallback
options.body: When `CODEX_PATH` is unset, resolve `codex` from the child PATH and inject it for Codex launches, accepting the risk of selecting a user-managed binary.

recommendation.title: Bump adapter with diagnostics
recommendation.body: Compat-test a newer `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp` range, update registry/tests/docs/skill notes, and add enough startup diagnostics for blocked or missing nested Codex binaries.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged Codex adapter switch and docs/tests that define the affected built-in launcher surface.
